contentList.content: WuXia

WuXia warriors are masters of internal energy cultivation and sword qi techniques. They practice the Great Vajra Divine Power to enhance their attack potency, possess eagle-like keen vision, and can unleash the legendary Six Meridian Divine Sword, attacking enemies with invisible sword qi. 3rd Level - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="WuXia_DaJinGangShenLi">Great Vajra Divine Power</LSTag>, learn Six Meridian Divine Sword 7th Level - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="WuXia_YingYan">Eagle Eye</LSTag>, learn more sword qi 10th Level - Learn ultimate skill <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="WuXia_LiuMaiShenJian">Six Meridian Divine Sword</LSTag>
Great Vajra Divine Power

Cultivate internal energy to enhance attack power. When using finesse weapons, deal additional force damage equal to Strength modifier (minimum 1); when using heavy weapons, deal additional force damage equal to Strength modifier (minimum 2); when using versatile weapons, deal additional force damage equal to Strength modifier (minimum 1).
Eagle Eye

Possess eagle-like keen vision and perception. Gain 60 feet <LSTag Tooltip="Darkvision">Darkvision</LSTag>, immunity to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinded</LSTag> condition, and 50% increased range for ranged weapons.
Shao Shang Sword
Sword qi from the Hand Taiyin Lung Meridian. Launch invisible sword qi to attack enemies, dealing 1d20 force damage and granting the target advantage on their next attack. Cost: 1 Bonus Action
Shang Yang Sword

Sword qi from the Hand Yangming Large Intestine Meridian. Launch invisible sword qi to attack enemies, dealing 1d20 force damage and making the target <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>. Cost: 1 Bonus Action
Zhong Chong Sword

Sword qi from the Hand Jueyin Pericardium Meridian. Launch invisible sword qi to attack enemies, dealing 1d20 force damage and making the target <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">Stunned</LSTag>. Cost: 1 Bonus Action
Guan Chong Sword

Sword qi from the Hand Shaoyang Triple Energizer Meridian. Launch invisible sword qi to attack enemies, dealing 1d20 force damage and making the target <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="VULNERABLE_FORCE">Vulnerable</LSTag> to force damage for 2 turns. Cost: 1 Bonus Action
Shao Chong Sword

Sword qi from the Hand Shaoyin Heart Meridian. Launch invisible sword qi to attack enemies, dealing 1d20 force damage and making the target <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frightened</LSTag> for 2 turns. Cost: 1 Bonus Action
Shao Ze Sword

Sword qi from the Hand Taiyang Small Intestine Meridian. Launch invisible sword qi to attack enemies, dealing 1d20 force damage and making the target <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SLOWED">Slowed</LSTag> for 2 turns. Cost: 1 Bonus Action
Six Meridian Divine Sword

The ultimate mastery of the Six Meridian Divine Sword. Simultaneously launch six sword qi to attack enemies, dealing 6d20+6d6 force damage and applying all six sword qi effects: advantage, prone, stunned, force vulnerability, frightened, and slowed. Cost: 1 Action Point Cooldown: Once per Short Rest
